base: all 20 choza renders, grouped by legwear assertion
observation: hair/dress saturation (purple hue window, V>=150) moves with the LEGWEAR tags alone: 113-125 with the pair, 90 with gradient-only 1.25, 50-53 with legwear removed -- hair is never named in any patch. Dark-garment saturation moves identically (114-180 vs 51-59). Conditioning is global: the tights tags select the vivid-purple-character training population, and hair/hoodie/backdrop ride along. Purple is ONE axis (repin's single 170-225 window exists for this reason; .local/desat.py's docstring recorded the same pull in the other direction). Separation of 'asserted tights, pale hair' is not expressible in-prompt; it is the delivery's job. Proof: repin on ic1s0w pinned purple 0.62/0.36 with skin untouched, V untouched -- hair stays lavender, gradient keeps its shape, fig mid 70.9->44.0, light 63.7->43.8. The earlier 'repin bleaches hair' failure was a light-177 catastrophic rescue; from the 60-90 range it holds.
